regionSource.comments: Mid forecast: Prime East colocation IT load trajectory (1.3 GW in 2024 to 3.3 GW by 2029-2030). High forecast: Borderstep/ResearchAndMarkets total capacity (4.8 GW by 2030, includes hyperscale AI/HPC expansion of up to 2,000 MW). 2025e baseline from GlobeNewsWire DCCP report (>1,400 MW mid-2025). Frankfurt accounts for >60% of market. Grid connection delays of 7+ years constrain the low scenario. Intermediate years interpolated. Germany's Energy Efficiency Act requires PUE 1.3 by 2030.
